definitions.ell: effective service/combat learning coefficient over the chosen time unit

interpretation: Replacement/expansion is a quality-dilution flow while operational exposure is a learning flow. A force can recover or expand personnel while average experience falls if turnover outruns learning.
combat_extension: Combat adds event-dependent learning with coefficient combat.momentum_learning_rate*0.025*exposure, raising the replacement-flow threshold a formation can tolerate before average experience declines. Do not combine patrol and combat learning into a calendar-time threshold without an explicit contact process.
guard: Analytic consequence of implemented Pineland mixing/learning equations. Annualized patrol-only examples are illustrative model quantities, not empirical turnover thresholds for real armed forces.
